title: Akiyama Mizuki — Perfect Presentation!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, Li'l Bro! Oh, Toya, you're here too♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Pretty rare of you. I didn't know you were at school today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I need to keep my attendance up.
I was apparently right on the line, so I had to be a good student and...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What part of you is a good student...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
We were just about to have lunch.
Did you already buy something, Akiyama?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I got some sandwiches at the convenience store on my way over!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, mind if I join you guys?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Stay if you like.
I mean, that's why you're here, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yup.
Anyway, let's eat♪

rows.Speaker: Toya & Akito
rows.Line: Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, I heard something about you working at a cafe...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, just for a day!
Did Ena tell you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, it sounded pretty rough.
You had to deal with a TV shoot and big group at the same time, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We did! The cafe's longtime veteran couldn't make it that day, so Airi asked me to fill in.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Didn't that require quite a bit of courage? You'd never worked in food service before, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, it did. But I needed the money because there was this asset that I really wanted to get.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, I don't like tooting my own horn, but I am pretty good at decorating stuff.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Actually, wanna see the Mount Everest strawberry parfait I worked on?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Mount Everest?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Check it out! What do you think? The fruits and dollops of whipped cream look perfect, don't they?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you did a good job of creating a nice balance.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it looks pretty, but this thing looks enormous.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! They actually used this one during the shoot... I think for the close-up!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's remarkable.
Does that mean you were also interviewed, Akiyama?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Me? No, they didn't interview me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You should've seen the film crew. They were all like, “They've got some real cuties working here! Get your cameras on them!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No, they didn't.
They were there for the cafe, not its workers.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! You got me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, I feel like it'd be a huge pain if I got famous for some weird reason. I'd much rather have MMJ hog the spotlight!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, there's the bell.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we should start heading back to our classrooms.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. Anyway, I'm glad we could chat! Thanks for letting me have lunch with you guys!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure thing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now, before I head back to my own classroom...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Li'l Bro, can I borrow your math textbook♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What...? This was your plan all along? Not lunch?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Can't you just ask whoever's sitting next to you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That'd make it harder for them to absorb what's going on in class. Isn't that unfair to them?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, Li'l Bro, please!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: My class is apparently a little ahead, so I'll jot down the answers and notes to all the problems for you in return.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, it's yours.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I heard that, Akito.
You need to do those problems yourself. Otherwise you won't—

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I'm not gonna cheat or anything.
I'm just being a nice person by doing a nice thing for a friend. That's all.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Exactly♪
Thanks for letting me borrow this!
